steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: NEA Task 1 is a food investigation worth 15% of the total GCSE grade (AQA 8585). It is completed in controlled conditions over approximately 10 hours. | Key Fact: The investigation assesses students' understanding of the working characteristics, functional properties, and chemical processes of ingredients. | Key Fact: Task 1 involves: researching the given brief, conducting practical experiments, recording results, and writing a scientific report (1,500–2,000 words plus supporting evidence). | Key Fact: A typical Task 1 brief might ask you to investigate how different raising agents affect the volume and texture of a sponge cake, or how different fats affect pastry shortness.
